update_procedure: Land the table change in Pulp first.
Copy Pulp's tools/scripts/vellum_mirror_edge_patterns.json at a Pulp main commit byte-for-byte to tools/provenance/mirror_edge_patterns.json.
Set pulp_commit to that commit and git_blob to `git -C <pulp> rev-parse <commit>:tools/scripts/vellum_mirror_edge_patterns.json`.

Run python3 tools/provenance/test_verify_extraction.py and python3 tools/provenance/verify_extraction.py --mirror-edge-pulp-root <pulp checkout at pulp_commit>; the provenance-verify lane repeats the second check on every event.
